findings.title: Why Base Laya Dumps Child Inputs to Injections
findings.body: On raw zero-shot base Laya, 14 out of 20 direct child inputs were classified as reject_untrusted_text (20.0% accuracy). Laya lacks generative safety alignment; without explicit schema bounds, the raw head latches onto the prompt injection definition.

findings.title: The Surface-Scoping Transformation (20% → 48%)
findings.body: Simply eliminating reject_untrusted_text from valid child options more than doubles base Laya accuracy (to 48.0%), correctly recognizing 80% of sensitive boundaries (reproduction, puberty, acid burns, war curriculum) where regex failed completely.

findings.title: Regex Catastrophic Failure (24%)
findings.body: Production regex achieved 24.0% accuracy with 0% crisis recall (misses bleeding, poison, indirect despair) and 0% injection recall, while falsely blocking benign biology curriculum (puberty, swear word clarification).

findings.title: TypeSafe JEV Sets the Ceiling (96%)
findings.body: TypeSafe JEV scores 96.0% (24/25) on the contrast suite with 100% crisis recall, 100% refusal recall, and 100% prompt injection recall, setting the benchmark standard for our upcoming Laya RLCD fine-tune.
